capabilities: publish notes to Feishu/Lark as Docx documents in a chosen folder
publish notes as Notion pages under a shared Integration parent page
create new ima notes in a selected knowledge base or folder
write remote URLs (lark_url, notion_url, ima_note_id) into note frontmatter
retry only failed publishes from a completion report
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool; it publishes one-way and never merges remote changes back into the vault.
extras: README is primarily in Chinese with an English link; detailed per-platform configuration, capability matrix, and troubleshooting docs are linked externally. The plugin was awaiting Obsidian community marketplace review at the time of writing, with BRAT and manual release installation described as alternatives. Credentials are stored in Obsidian SecretStorage and the plugin states it has no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to Feishu/Lark, Notion, or ima, and no guard against accidentally mixing remote edits back into the vault.

requires.name: Feishu/Lark, Notion, or ima account with API credentials

summary: One-way publisher that sends Obsidian Markdown notes to Feishu/Lark, Notion, and ima, treating the local vault as the only content source.
